ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2022 Revision); Interim Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information in the Field of Anti-Money Laundering (PBOC Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Measures for the Registration of Beneficial Owner Information by the State Administration for Market Regulation; Company Law of the PRC (revised 2023); Counterterrorism Law of the PRC.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Singapore Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a Singapore notary public, then apostille issued by the Singapore Academy of Law under the Hague Apostille Convention; delivered with certified Chinese translation; consular legalization is not applied because Singapore is an Apostille Contracting State. For a document originating in a non-Apostille state, the only parallel and mutually exclusive route is notarization plus Ministry of Foreign Affairs legalization plus Embassy/Consulate legalization of the People's Republic of China; the two routes are never chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Singapore Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a Singapore notary public, then apostille by the Singapore Academy of Law; a Chinese translation by a certified translator is attached. This apostille route is used because Singapore is a Hague Apostille Convention member; no consular legalization step applies.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney for incorporation of the WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company board of directors (issued under seal; notarization by a Singapore notary public)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Board resolution signed by directors, notarized by a Singapore notary public, then apostilled by the Singapore Academy of Law under the Hague Apostille Convention; submitted to SAMR with certified Chinese translation; consular legalization is not required.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (or constitutive charter) of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor (registered in Singapore; ACRA certified extract)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Extract of the Articles of Association certified by ACRA, notarized by a Singapore notary, apostilled by the Singapore Academy of Law; Chinese translation included. Apostille route only; consular legalization is not applicable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign investor (with creditworthiness statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signed and stamped by the account officer, notarized by a Singapore notary public, apostilled by the Singapore Academy of Law under the Hague Apostille Convention; Chinese translation attached. This document may not be consular-legalized; the apostille route is exclusive.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Screening against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, the Chinese MFA terrorist lists, and the SAMR/PBOC beneficial owner registry. All UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories must be screened for politically exposed persons using a tiered risk classification, including family members and close associates. Any PEP matched to a high-risk jurisdiction triggers enhanced due diligence with source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation. Adverse media, regulatory actions, bankruptcy, and criminal records are reviewed. Screening is refreshed at onboarding, before any material transaction, and at least quarterly thereafter.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR Online Enterprise Registration and Name Pre-approval Portal (National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, NECIPS) and the enterprise name reservation module of the local Market Supervision Administration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Chinese enterprise name must be composed of standardized Chinese characters and follow a four-tier structure: (1) administrative division, (2) unique distinguishing name, (3) industry or business characteristics, (4) legal form. A WFOE may register an English parallel name through the same application, but the Chinese name prevails. Foreign-language transliteration must respect Mandarin pronunciation and registered trademarks; the name may not be misleading, contrary to public interests, or infringe prior names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon receipt of a written rejection from SAMR, the applicant may resubmit a corrected name after 15 days for simple amendments. An administrative reconsideration application may be filed with the same-level People's Government within 60 days of the rejection. If reconsideration fails or is not decided within 45 days, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit with the intermediate people's court within 6 months of the original rejection. For conflicts with prior names, submit consent letters or demonstrate prior use and acquired reputation. Engage the local SAMR pre-approval window for informal guidance before filing the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices and commercial mailboxes are not accepted as a statutory registered address for a WFOE under current SAMR practice and bank account requirements. The WFOE must have a physical leased or owned office space in the registered city, evidenced by a lease agreement with a term of at least six months, utility receipts, and proof that the landlord recognizes the office as a business premise. For ISIC 7020 advisory services, a serviced office with a dedicated meeting room and a clear address may be acceptable, but pure mail-forwarding services are rejected by tax bureaus and banks.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: employees present vs declared; business license displayed; rent invoices and payment vouchers; authenticity of corporate seal usage; books and records availability; VAT invoice patterns. Quantified risk: low-to-moderate; a 25-35% probability of an unannounced inspection within the first 12 months, increasing if abnormal VAT invoicing or tax arrears appear. Keep all compliance records at the registered office and ensure a responsible person is available during tax office visits.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name pre-approval and company registration filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / local Market Supervision Administration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government fee is nil (no official registration fee charged in China since 2015).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille of foreign investor documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Singapore notary public and Singapore Academy of Law
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notary and apostille tariff in Singapore (approx. SGD 40 per document for apostille plus notary fees).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Chinese translation and notary stamping of the five-document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translation agency and PRC notary office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark translation rate: USD 25-35 per page; notary translation attestation USD 20-40.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office (serviced office) first-year lease and deposit provision
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial landlord of a registered serviced office in Shanghai or Beijing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market lease rate for service offices in first-tier city business districts, approx. USD 180-250 per square meter per year; provision for deposit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account opening fee and first-year account maintenance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank tariff schedule for WFOE current account opening and first-year monthly maintenance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Local corporate counsel fee for incorporation dossier, name clearance, and UBO filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a standard WFOE incorporation with tax registration and UBO filing: USD 1,500-3,000.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed seal engraving company registered with public security
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Quoted public security-approved tariff for official company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal, and invoice seal.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), Articles 23-30, 43-50; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019, effective from 2020), Articles 6-10; Regulations Implementing the Foreign Investment Law (2020, State Council Decree No. 723), Articles 5-12.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) - Enterprise Registration Bureau, acting through the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation where the company's registered office is located.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application Form for Company Establishment Registration combined with the approved Articles of Association (公司章程), submitted through the National Enterprise Registration Portal; the issuance of the Business License (营业执照) constitutes the official certificate of incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None - China imposes no statutory minimum registered capital for a consulting WFOE. The shareholders determine the registered capital in the Articles of Association, but under the 2023 Company Law the initial contribution must be at least 30% within six months and the balance within five years. No escrowed blocked account is mandated; however, contributed capital must be remitted in compliance with PRC foreign exchange rules and reported to the local State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) branch.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY_NAME] CO., LTD. (a wholly foreign-owned enterprise incorporated under the laws of the People's Republic of China)

The undersigned, being the duly appointed members of the first Board of Directors (the 'Board') of the Company, acting in accordance with the Articles of Association and the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, hereby adopt the following resolutions by unanimous written consent, and such consent shall be effective as of [DATE], 2025.

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND ISSUE. The Board ratifies the issuance and subscription of the Company's registered capital in the aggregate amount of [USD EQUIVALENT] as set out in the Articles of Association. Each shareholder shall contribute the initial tranche of not less than 30% of the subscribed capital within six months of incorporation and the balance within five years, subject to the governing foreign exchange and foreign investment rules. The Board authorises the general manager to open a capital verification account with the designated bank, instruct the shareholders to effect faithful remittance of their contributions, and obtain the bank-issued capital contribution statement for statutory filing.

2. BANKING AND FINANCING AUTHORIZATION. The Board authorises the opening of RMB and foreign currency bank accounts with [BANK NAME] located at [BRANCH ADDRESS]. The chairperson, the general manager, and the finance director are hereby appointed as authorised joint signatories on all corporate bank accounts. Any wire transfer or payment exceeding [USD AMOUNT] shall require the joint authorisation of at least two designated signatories. The Board adopts the standard bank account resolution and expressly directs the finance director to complete all customer due diligence and statutory reporting obligations with the relevant financial regulator.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The Board adopts the registered office located at [FULL ADDRESS], [CITY], People's Republic of China, as the statutory seat of the Company. The lease agreement for the registered office is hereby ratified and accepted. The Board directs company counsel to file the registered office details with the local Administration for Market Regulation and to ensure that the registered office is available during business hours for service of process and official correspondence.

4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. The Board appoints [NAME] as legal representative and chairman of the board, [NAME] as general manager, [NAME] as chief financial officer, and [NAME] as supervisor, each to act until removal or resignation by the shareholders. The legal representative is hereby vested with the authority to sign incorporation-related amendments, employment contracts, and any contracts within the ordinary course of business. The supervisor shall exercise independent oversight over the management and shall render reports solely to the shareholders.

5. GOVERNANCE AND GENERAL AUTHORIZATION. The Board authorises the company counsel and certified public accountants to prepare and submit all statutory filings, annual reports, tax returns, and audit reports under applicable PRC law. Management is further directed to adopt anti-money-laundering and know-your-customer procedures, to maintain strict segregation of client funds, and to comply with the applicable corporate governance and AML/CFT obligations. This resolution shall be effective immediately and shall remain binding upon the Company, its shareholders, and its successors in interest. Dated this [DATE] at [CITY], People's Republic of China.

Signed by all of the directors: [DIRECTOR 1], [DIRECTOR 2], [DIRECTOR 3].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Business Scope Pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Registration Portal operated under the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The applicant must prepare a proposed Chinese company name (and optionally an English name), an exhaustive business scope expressed in standard SAMR terminology, the intended registered capital, and the proposed legal representative. The application is submitted electronically through the SAMR online name reservation system or the integrated government one-stop platform. The business scope for a tax structuring consultancy must expressly include 'corporate management consulting', 'tax advisory', and 'business information consultation'. The name approval will be validated against trademark conflicts and prohibited civil law expressions. Notarization is not required at this stage; however, if the founder is a foreign corporate entity, a certified extract or certificate of good standing must accompany any future filing. The approval is valid for six months and must be renewed if the WFOE is not registered before expiry.
required_dossiers: Completed company name reservation application
Proposed Chinese and English business scope text
Identity or registration documents of each shareholder
Proposed registered capital distribution table
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected for reason of similarity, prohibited wording, or public interest, the legal counsel shall within 5 working days submit a revised application using alternative candidate names. A formal administrative review may also be requested from the SAMR within 60 days of rejection if a lawful right is allegedly undermined.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Establishment Registration and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The WFOE establishment application is submitted to the local municipal SAMR office, either through the online National Enterprise Registration Portal or at the physical government service centre. The applicant must file the finalised Articles of Association signed by all shareholders or their lawful representatives, the appointment forms for the legal representative, director(s), and supervisor, the lease agreement plus property ownership certificate for the registered office, and the identity or corporate registration documents of the investors. If any shareholder is a foreign corporation, its certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing must be notarised and legalised or apostilled as applicable, and if a foreign individual, a notarised passport copy is required. The municipal SAMR will conduct an administrative review of the application and verify that the proposed business scope complies with the Foreign Investment Negative List. Upon approval, the SAMR issues the electronic Business License, which integrates tax registration, statistical registration, and social insurance registration under the 'multi-license integration' regime.
required_dossiers: Signed Articles of Association
Application for Company Establishment Registration
Identity documents and appointment letters of directors, legal representative, and supervisor
Registered office lease agreement and property ownership certificate
Certificate of incorporation and good standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
Notarised passport or corporate extract for individual shareholders
Power of attorney in favour of the local filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a deficiency notice, the company must cure the deficiencies within 15 days by submitting amended or supplemental documents. If the application is rejected on legal grounds, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration with the local municipal government within 60 days, or file an administrative lawsuit with the people's court within six months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License Issuance and Official Company Seal Engraving
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR and Public Security Bureau through licensed seal engraving firms
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the municipal SAMR grants approval, the company downloads the electronic Business License from the portal and obtains the original paper license at the government service centre or by authorised courier if available in the applicable jurisdiction. Within 30 calendar days after license issuance, the company must engage a licensed seal engraving enterprise approved by the local Public Security Bureau to engrave four official seals: the company seal (公章), finance seal (财务专用章), legal representative seal (法定代表人章), and contract seal (合同专用章). Each newly engraved seal is to be filed with the Public Security Bureau using the business license reference and the legal representative's identity. No banking transaction, tax invoice, or material contract can be executed before the seal recordation is complete.
required_dossiers: Original Business License or electronic licence download code
Legal representative ID card or passport
Name reservation certificate or establishment registration acceptance number
SAMR notification of successful incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal engraving or registration is denied due to inconsistent documentary data, request a correction from SAMR by submitting the employment certificate of the legal representative, then resubmit the seal registration application to the Public Security Bureau without additional government fee except the engraving charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Registrations and Tax Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Taxation Administration (local tax service office); local Social Insurance Bureau; local branch of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after the Business License is issued, the WFOE must complete or confirm its automatic tax registration through the National Tax Service Platform, obtain the taxpayer identification number as embedded in the cargo license, choose between small-scale and general VAT taxpayer status, and register with the local Social Insurance Bureau for social insurance obligations. If the WFOE plans to receive foreign capital, an FDI registration record must be completed with the local SAFE branch, typically through the banks after opening the capital account. The company should also obtain electronic invoicing capacity and apply for any VAT ordinary invoices or special invoices required to bill advisory services. A blank statistics registration is not required separately because the multi-license integration regime covers the statistical and civil code registration.
required_dossiers: Business License (original or electronic)
Articles of Association
Legal representative and finance director identification
Bank account basic deposit registration form after bank account opening
Shareholder list and registered capital amount
Lease agreement for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is queried because the capital contribution has not yet been remitted, the company may present the bank capital verification statement together with a letter of undertaking and complete the contribution verification within the statutory period. If the social insurance registration is held pending incomplete employment contracts, resolve by submitting the standard employment contracts and the designated payroll records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Foreign Capital Contribution Remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated commercial bank (with SAFE accreditation) and the local SAFE branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The WFOE must open a basic deposit account with a licensed commercial bank, in addition to a capital account if non-RMB capital will be injected. The bank will perform a mandatory know-your-customer inquiry, verify the Business License, Articles of Association, board resolution on banking authorisation, beneficial owner declarations, and proof of business substance such as the registered office lease and anticipated commercial contracts. Once the account is open, the shareholders must remit the subscribed registered capital to the company's capital account under the relevant foreign exchange controls. Following the inflow, the company must complete the foreign exchange registration record with SAFE through the bank within 15 working days, obtain a capital contribution verification certificate, and thereafter the funds may be converted into RMB for operational use subject to SAFE rules. For a pure advisory WFOE, there is no restrictive industry-specific license to obtain.
required_dossiers: Business License (original)
Approved Articles of Association
First board resolution authorising bank account signature powers
Legal representative and finance director valid identity documents
SAFE foreign exchange registration record or FDI reporting file
Board resolution on beneficial ownership and AML/KYC disclosure
Registered office lease and proof of business substance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the foreign exchange remittance is rejected by the bank due to discrepancy in the SAFE registration or alleged lack of economic substance, the applicant shall rectify the SAFE filing with the help of a licensed accountant and resubmit the remittance instruction. If the bank refuses account opening for AML reasons, the WFOE may apply to a different licensed bank after correcting the compliance documentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - pure tax structuring and management consultancy falling under ISIC 7020; no industrial, manufacturing, physical assembly, or warehousing licensing board applies.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no industrial or physical operating license required; the only statutory operating authorization is the general Business License (营业执照) issued by SAMR.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) review is not triggered by a consulting office.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA classification category applies because the enterprise performs no construction, manufacturing, chemical processing, or physical discharge activities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero wastewater, zero industrial VOC emissions, and zero hazardous waste generation. The company must only comply with ordinary municipal office waste disposal obligations and the general cleanliness requirements under local environmental sanitation regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable - no Civil Defense fire certificate, structural load inspection, or workplace safety industrial approval is mandatory for a professional consulting office. Nonetheless, the registered office lease must designate the premises as commercial use, and the company shall comply with the Work Safety Law of the People's Republic of China by implementing basic fire prevention measures, maintaining unobstructed egress, and ensuring general workplace safety. If the local district fire service requires a simple annual fire inspection for any commercial office, the company shall cooperate and obtain the certificate of conformity before full operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA) with local municipal/provincial tax service bureaus; online portal is the State Taxation Administration Electronic Taxpayer Service Platform (e-Tax) at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn and corresponding provincial e-Tax portals.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Because the WFOE is a China-resident enterprise, the tax identification number is the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) printed on the business license issued by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). Procedure: (1) complete name pre-approval and foreign investment admission filings (the consultancy activity is not on the foreign investment negative list); (2) file incorporation documents with SAMR and obtain the Business License containing the USCC, which is the statutory TIN for tax, customs, social insurance and banking purposes; (3) complete tax registration within 30 days through the e-Tax portal by authenticating the legal representative's real-name identity and filing supplementary taxpayer information, accounting standards, bank account details and contact persons with the competent local STA tax service bureau; (4) activate VAT taxpayer status and Digital Electronic Invoice issuance in the national VAT invoice system, and apply for general VAT taxpayer status if annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000 or electively when below that threshold; (5) register employee payroll withholding and social insurance. A non-resident foreign enterprise without a Chinese entity does not receive a full TIN; it obtains a non-resident tax reference record from the STA for withholding and filing obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (no check-the-box or pass-through entity election exists for WFOEs under PRC tax law; hybrid mismatch rules do not provide elective classification). The only relevant statutory election is VAT status: a taxpayer with annual taxable turnover not exceeding RMB 5,000,000 may elect to register as a small-scale VAT taxpayer, while general VAT taxpayer registration is mandatory once annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the VAT Law of the People's Republic of China, the transitional VAT rules in Caishui [2016] No. 36 and subsequent STA implementing announcements
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold triggers basic VAT registration for a China-established WFOE; any entity with taxable business activities must register upon establishment. For general VAT taxpayer status, the statutory registration threshold is annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000; taxpayers below that threshold may elect general status or remain small-scale.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China requires all VAT taxpayers to use the STA-controlled national VAT invoice system, now operated as the fully digitalized Digital Electronic Invoice system under Golden Tax Phase IV. Invoices are issued through the e-Tax platform using tax-authority-allocated invoice numbers and encrypted anti-fraud digital stamping, with real-time data clearing that cross-matches issued invoices, VAT credit claims and filed VAT returns. Approved enterprises may integrate issuance through authorized ERP/API channels, but all invoices are subject to STA clearance and risk-based issuance quotas.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported from China qualify for zero-rated VAT treatment under the export tax rebate regime once the goods are actually declared to customs and leave the PRC. For this WFOE's international tax structuring and transfer pricing advisory services, zero-rating is not the governing treatment; instead, the services fall within the cross-border VAT exemption category for consulting services supplied to overseas entities and wholly consumed outside China. The exemption requires that (i) the recipient is an overseas unit without a China establishment using the service for its China business, (ii) the service is performed and consumed entirely outside China, (iii) the WFOE files the cross-border taxable service exemption record with the STA through the e-Tax portal, and (iv) the WFOE retains evidence of actual offshore service delivery and foreign currency repatriation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration of the People's Republic of China (export bill of entry)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or international transport document issued by the carrier
Export sales contract and purchase order
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or equivalent bank foreign-exchange receipt advice evidencing repatriation of export proceeds
Cross-border service contract and detailed service delivery report (for cross-border services)
STA e-Tax portal record of the cross-border taxable service exemption filing (for cross-border services)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating and cross-border service exemption claims are subject to documentary audit by the STA and customs/tax police coordination. If the underlying documents do not substantiate the export or offshore consumption, the tax authority retroactively reverses the tax benefit, requires output VAT to be declared and paid together with statutory late-payment surcharge, disallows the corresponding input VAT credits, and may impose an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid VAT under the PRC Tax Collection Administration Law. Fraudulent use of forged, falsified or recycled documents to obtain an export tax rebate can constitute criminal tax fraud under PRC Criminal Law, with penalties including imprisonment up to life for large amounts, confiscation of property, and an unlimited or extended retrospective assessment period for confirmed fraud or concealment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate system with RMB convertible on current account for genuine trade and service transactions but subject to a regulated capital account. The WFOE may legally receive equity investment and pay international tax advisory fees abroad if the underlying contracts, invoices, and tax residency certificates are presented to the bank; the Foreign Exchange Administration verifies the transaction before release. Dividend and profit remittance requires an annual audit by a Chinese CPA, a tax clearance or withholding tax payment certificate, board resolution on profit distribution, and a SAFE-registered capital account; remittance is permitted after corporate income tax and dividend withholding tax are settled. Surrender requirements are currently settlement-based: export and service proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic FX settlement account and may be retained in foreign currency or voluntarily converted into RMB; there is no fixed mandatory percentage conversion. However, the bank is obliged to verify the nature of funds under the cross-border receipt and payment verification system and monitor consistency with declared purpose. Capital inflows require SAFE FDI registration and an equity entry record; conversion of capital is strictly purpose-bound and cannot be used for securities or speculative activities. Current account freedom exists while capital account movement requires pre-registration, documentary compliance, and post-verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE settlement and sale of foreign exchange rules, goods export proceeds must be repatriated into China through a licensed bank and credited to the entity's Foreign Exchange Settlement Account within 180 days from customs declaration unless a SAFE-approved extension is obtained; there is no fixed mandatory conversion percentage since the abolition of forced surrender, so the exporter may voluntarily convert to RMB or retain foreign currency. Service trade income, including tax structuring consultancy fees, must be received by the contractual maturity date and verified with the service trade contract, commercial invoice, proof of service delivery, and tax payment documentation where applicable.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Settlement Account and Basic RMB Operational Account
General Operational Currency Account with Cross-Border Settlement Facility
Secondary RMB Operating Account and FX Disbursement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Not legally viable as the primary banking infrastructure. Under Chinese banking regulations, only licensed onshore commercial banks may open RMB current accounts, foreign currency capital accounts, and settlement accounts for a WFOE. Overseas fintech EMIs and digital banks licensed in other jurisdictions do not possess a Chinese banking license and are prohibited from maintaining onshore RMB or foreign currency accounts, performing SAFE registrations, completing capital verification, or clearing statutory cross-border tax and trade payments. Such platforms may serve only as an offshore treasury visibility layer; the statutory corporate banking, FDI capital injection, tax remittance, and regulatory reporting functions must remain with a domestic Tier-1 commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Statutory legal representatives and ultimate beneficial owners generally must physically appear at a bank branch for the initial KYC interview and signature specimen when opening the WFOE operational and capital accounts. Some banks permit a notarized and legalized power of attorney for a senior finance officer to act as account signatory, but the director and UBO must still pass compliance screening. Remote video verification is supplementary and does not fully waive the in-branch identity interview in enhanced due diligence cases. Consular proxy opening is not a generally available route; a consular notarized power of attorney may be accepted only with strict internal approval and the physical presence of the authorized representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore parent entity with an indirect ownership chain spanning multiple jurisdictions and incomplete corporate registry evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copies of incorporation documents and constitutional minutes for each entity in the ownership chain, corporate registry extracts dated within 90 days, a notarized UBO declaration covering all natural persons holding 10% or more, passport and residence proof for each UBO, a direct and indirect shareholding chart, and an independent legal opinion confirming absence of bearer shares, nominee concealment, or unidentifiable trusts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media, sanctions list, or politically exposed person screening hit against a director or shareholder, especially when common-name matches appear in international watchlists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A qualified sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening report produced by a reputable provider, accompanied by a written explanation differentiating the matched individual, official police clearance certificates from the residence jurisdiction, court or litigation absence certificates, passport page images, complete visa history, and a board resolution acknowledging an ongoing enhanced monitoring condition if residual risk remains.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business scope mismatch between a low-capital tax structuring consultancy WFOE and large projected cross-border advisory invoices, suggesting possible invoice washing or concealed related-party transactions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Entity-level and transactional transfer pricing documentation prepared under OECD and Chinese TP rules for ISIC 7020, signed client engagement agreements, detailed project deliverables, time sheets, fee schedules aligned with services, office lease and payroll evidence showing local substance, professional licenses, a projected cash-flow model, and an invoice register matching each counterparty to a legitimate service.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient independent verification of the source of funds used for inbound FDI capital injection and subsequent profit remittance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of overseas parent bank statements tracing lawful accumulated profits or external financing, a shareholder loan agreement if applicable, audited financial statements of the remitter, board minutes approving the equity injection and any dividend distribution, a Chinese CPA capital verification report for paid-in capital, full corporate income tax and dividend withholding tax payment certificates, and an auditor's confirmation that no funds derived from cryptocurrencies, gambling, or unregulated money services businesses.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity funds should be remitted by SWIFT MT103 from the overseas parent to the WFOE's SAFE-registered foreign currency capital account at the chosen Tier-1 domestic bank. The remittance instruction must contain the beneficiary WFOE legal name, the SAFE-registered capital account number, and the foreign exchange payment purpose code corresponding to direct investment capital injection. The bank requires the FDI registration certificate, shareholders' resolution, articles of association, and a written explanation of the investment purpose to be submitted before or simultaneously with the incoming wire. Upon receipt, the bank performs post-verification in the SAFE system, records the capital entry, and permits conversion to RMB only for expenditures stated in the approved business plan. A Chinese certified public accountant must then issue a capital verification report confirming paid-in capital. The WFOE may not use capital funds for entrusted loans, securities investments, speculative real estate acquisition, or any other purpose outside the approved business scope.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound cross-border trade and service disbursements are executed predominantly through SWIFT MT103 wire transfers with full supporting documentation attached under bank advice: for tax structuring consultancy services, the bank requires a service trade contract, commercial invoice, delivered work product evidence, and tax withholding or payment certificates where foreign service providers are subject to Chinese taxes. If the WFOE also handles physical goods as an ancillary trade activity, Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700) and Documentary Collections may be used, but services should not be routed through LCs because no transport documents exist. Dividend and profit repatriation uses MT103 with a board distribution resolution, audited financial statements, tax clearance certificates, and the SAFE-registered remittance basis. All outbound payments must flow through the bank's cross-border payment verification system, with CNAPS for domestic RMB legs and CIPS or the clearing bank's RMB cross-border channel for international RMB payment instructions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB FX forward contracts with licensed Chinese banks limited to genuine current and capital account exposures evidenced by trade, service, or profit remittance documentation

Onshore FX swaps for real-exchange and back-exchange of principal between RMB and foreign currency, confined to temporary liquidity needs arising from operating cash flows and capital account timetables

Cross-currency swaps permitted only for long-term balance-sheet hedging of FDI capital, project financing, or recognized funding liabilities, with SAFE-compliant underlying exposure and bank credit approval
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible for an onshore WFOE as hedging instruments; the NDF market is offshore-only and cannot be booked through a Chinese bank for this entity

Currency options may be permitted on a real-exposure basis where the WFOE has obtained derivative eligibility under the bank's risk-management framework and the underlying exposure is verifiable; speculative derivative positions are strictly prohibited

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Report (Annual Return) filed under the Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Publicity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each calendar year for the preceding fiscal year (January 1 - December 31)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by June 30 places the company on the 'Abnormal Operations List'; if this remains unrectified for three consecutive years, the company is referred to the 'Serious Illegal and Dishonest List' and may face revocation of its business license, with related administrative restrictions on directors, supervisors, and legal representatives.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report under the Measures for the Reporting of Foreign Investment Information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), collected electronically through the SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each calendar year covering the previous year's foreign investment data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the report is not submitted, the commerce authority issues a rectification order; failure to rectify within the stated period attracts a fine of CNY 10,000 to CNY 30,000, increasing to CNY 30,000 to CNY 100,000 for serious cases, plus potential restrictions on further foreign investment filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement (Annual Enterprise Income Tax Reconciliation Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration / local competent tax authority (host tax bureau)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five months after the close of the taxable year, i.e., on or before May 31 of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to CNY 2,000; for serious circumstances CNY 2,000 to CNY 10,000; daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax from the original due date; understatement or fraudulent underreporting may result in a tax penalty from 0.5 to 5 times the underpaid amount and criminal liability in severe cases.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption applies to PRC limited liability companies, including WFOEs; every company must have its annual financial statements audited by a licensed Chinese certified public accountant (CPA) firm. Additional audit triggers apply to financial institutions, insurance, securities, and listed companies under each regulator's quantitative solvency or asset rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards (CAS), substantially converged with IFRS, as the applicable local GAAP; qualifying small enterprises may apply the Simplified Small Enterprise Accounting Standard for internal books, but the annual statutory audit and tax basis must conform to CAS and PRC tax rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: PRC law does not maintain a separate public UBO register or require an annual UBO confirmation filing. Instead, the annual SAMR enterprise report requires confirmation of shareholding, contributors, and key control information. Any equity transfer or change in shareholders must be updated in the company's shareholder register and filed with the SAMR within 30 days from the date the change resolution is made; foreign-investment information change reports must also be filed with the commerce authority as required.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders' and Directors' Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - USD 2,000 per year for registered address, corporate agent, and compliance support in major Chinese cities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 8,000 per year depending on transactional volume, intercompany financing, and transfer pricing documentation

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying small low-profit enterprises benefit from an effective 5% CIT rate on annual taxable income up to RMB 3 million under the 2023-2027 extension; high-tech enterprises enjoy a 15% preferential rate; eligible R&D expenses receive an additional 100% super deduction; Hainan Free Trade Zone encouraged-industry enterprises may use a 15% rate, and certain software/integrated-circuit design enterprises are eligible for reduced rates or VAT rebates.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A - Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return (Form A100000 and associated schedules A101010, A102010, A105000, A105050, A107012, A108000) filed through the STA electronic tax bureau portal (e-Tax / etax.chinatax.gov.cn).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return is due by May 31 after the fiscal year-end, which is December 31 for calendar-year WFOEs; quarterly provisional returns are due within 15 days after each quarter-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number and entity legal personality details (Unified Social Credit Code, name, address, tax classification).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Chinese TIN of the WFOE only. The foreign parent's TIN must not be used on this line. Confirm the WFOE is registered as a resident enterprise, making it subject to worldwide income taxation, and that non-resident shareholders are not themselves declared on this domestic return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting revenue derived from consultancy, advisory, management, and cross-border tax structuring services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all revenue, including revenue from overseas clients, because the WFOE is a Chinese tax resident. For services delivered to a foreign parent without the WFOE having a foreign permanent establishment, the revenue is still potentially taxable in China. Apply foreign tax credits strictly on Schedule A108000 only where provisionally paid abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable revenue and tax-exempt income lines (government grants, income specifically exempted under the CIT Law).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not exclude intercompany management fees or advisory recharges as non-taxable revenue. Only subsidised grants with an official exemption certificate are allowed; all fees received from the non-resident shareholder must be reported as gross revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs and expenses, including operating costs, salaries, rent, professional fees, interest, and depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the arm's length principle to every intercompany expense. Recharges from the foreign parent must be supported by contracts, itemised invoices, timesheets, and evidence of actual service receipt. Excessive management fees without economic substance must be added back to taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Additions and subtractions for permanent and timing differences, including fine deductions, entertainment, advertising, and salary caps.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Business entertainment is deductible at 60% of actual expenditure but capped at 5% of revenue. Payments made to shell entities are completely denied. The use of treaty-compliant invoicing does not override domestic expense-substance rules, and any disallowance increases taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate taxable income after loss carryforwards and exempt/non-taxable adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use tax losses only from arm's length transactions. Losses attributable to fabricated related-party pricing are disregarded. Carryforward is limited to 5 years; any carryback is unavailable. For the WFOE's foreign parent, this line has zero impact on the dividend withholding tax base at the entity level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of tentative tax, preferential tax rate, foreign tax credit, and final tax payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 25% headline rate, then subtract the small low-profit or high-tech preferential tax differentials using the proper schedules. Foreign tax credits must pass the itemised limit calculation under Schedule A108000; the tax paid on a foreign parent's repatriated profits is not creditable here because the WFOE is the taxpayer, not the parent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file by the statutory deadline exposes the WFOE to a fine of RMB 2,000, increased to RMB 10,000 for severe cases, under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law (TCAL); late payment triggers a daily surcharge of 0.05% of unpaid tax under Article 32; deliberately false filing is fraud under Article 63 and incurs a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax, and criminal prosecution arises where underpaid tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and 10% of the payable tax, leading to imprisonment under Criminal Law Article 201.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding income tax on dividends paid by a Chinese resident enterprise to a non-resident enterprise under Article 37 and Article 59 of the Corporate Income Tax Law, subject to treaty reduction, generally to 5% for a direct 25% or greater shareholding satisfying the holding-period requirement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority, provide a Beneficial Ownership self-declaration, prove the direct ownership percentage and the minimum holding period required by the applicable bilateral DTA, and submit these to the Chinese withholding agent and tax authority prior to remittance; the Chinese payer is required to withhold at the higher statutory rate until the treaty benefit is approved, and the shareholder must immediately report any change in beneficial ownership to the STA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on interest and royalties to non-residents is 10%; under representative DTAs, the rates may be reduced to 7% or 5% for interest and to 10% or 5% for royalties depending on the exact treaty article and the beneficial ownership conclusion, but all treaty reductions require a valid TRC and a substantive beneficial ownership analysis.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when related-party tangible-property transactions exceed RMB 200 million, intangible-property transactions exceed RMB 100 million, intercompany financial transactions exceed RMB 50 million, or other related-party transactions exceed RMB 40 million; Master File is mandatory where the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds RMB 5 billion or total cross-border related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China has no formal Economic Substance Regulations label, but the General Anti-Avoidance Rules in Articles 47 and 48 of the CIT Law and the substance-over-form doctrine mandate that a WFOE must conduct its Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) inside China, including strategic decision-making, employee deployment, contract negotiation, risk-taking, and invoice issuance. A WFOE that exists only on paper and channeling profits abroad is liable to be recharacterised or disregarded for tax purposes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Thin capitalisation and disguised profit repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE is funded through excessively large interest-bearing shareholder loans instead of equity, with a debt-to-equity ratio above the statutory 2:1 non-financial limit, causing the China tax base to be reduced by artificial interest deductions that function as a covert dividend distribution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 46 of the CIT Law denies the deduction for excess interest and Article 37 of the CIT Law recharacterises the disallowed interest as a deemed dividend subject to 10% withholding tax; Article 47 of the TCAL adds a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% and a penalty of 50% to 300% of the underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved the sham debt structure are personally liable under the veil-piercing rule in Article 20(3) of the Company Law, exposing their personal assets to restitution for the unpaid corporate tax; the legal representative may be placed on the tax blacklist and subjected to exit-control measures preventing travel abroad, and criminal tax evasion under Article 201 of the Criminal Law carries up to 7 years of imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company and absence of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE invoices large management consultancy and advisory fees to cross-border related parties while having no employees, no physical office, no active decision-making functions, and no risk-bearing capacity in China, in an artificial arrangement designed solely to shift profit away from China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The STA may invoke Article 47 of the CIT Law to disallow the arrangement and recast income, and Article 48 permits tax authorities to make a comprehensive income adjustment; Article 63 of the TCAL imposes a 50% to 500% penalty on the underpaid tax, plus possible daily surcharges from the due date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under Company Law Article 20, a director who caused or benefited from the artificial shell structure is jointly and severally liable for the shortfall, subject to civil asset restitution and freezing; the legal representative is subject to an exit ban until settlement is completed, and intentional evasion through false substance representations constitutes a criminal offence under Article 201 of the Criminal Law with penalties up to 7 years of imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Manipulated transfer pricing and fabricated documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE files a materially false Transfer Pricing Local File, applies a 2% cost-plus margin to a high-value cross-border advisory service where independent parties would earn at least 15%, and omits required related-party transaction declarations in the annual CIT return, resulting in understated taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 41 of the CIT Law authorises the STA to reassess taxable income on the arm's length basis; Article 44 of the TCAL allows imputed taxable income in the absence of documentation; Article 62 imposes fines of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 for non-filing, and Article 63 imposes a 50% to 500% fraud penalty with no statute of limitations for fraudulent conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who knowingly certified false transfer pricing documentation is personally responsible for the restitution of the underpaid tax after veil-piercing under the Company Law, can be blacklisted and denied cross-border travel by the exit control court mechanism, and, because deliberate document fabrication is a concealment strategy, Criminal Law Article 201 provides for imprisonment of up to 3 years where the evasion is substantial and up to 7 years for exceptionally large amounts.
